# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest released version of this package.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them privately using one of these channels:

1. **GitHub Security Advisories** (preferred): use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/zeeshantariq08/filament-sticky-columns/security/advisories/new) on this repository.
2. If that is unavailable, open a private discussion with the maintainer via the repository’s contact options on GitHub.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept if available
- Affected versions (and fixed versions if known)

You should receive an acknowledgement within **7 days**. Once a fix is available, a security advisory and release will be published as appropriate.

Thank you for helping keep this package and its users safe.
